title: § 28-304.2 Elevators, escalators, moving walkways, material lifts, man lifts and dumbwaiters.

blocks.html:
Elevators, escalators, moving walkways, material lifts, man lifts and dumbwaiters shall be inspected and tested in accordance with section 28-304.6, chapter 30 of the New York city building code, and the schedule set forth in Table N1 of ASME A17.1 as modified by chapter K1 of appendix K of the New York city building code.
(Am. L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 1/1/2022)
Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2008/008 and L.L. 2021/126.
